name: uzenofuzet
description: KRÉTA integrations for Claude: a hosted service and a desktop extension over one shared core.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @uzenofuzet/core && npm run build -w uzenofuzet-server && npm run build -w @uzenofuzet/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @uzenofuzet/core && npm run typecheck -w @uzenofuzet/core && npm run typecheck -w uzenofuzet-server && npm run typecheck -w @uzenofuzet/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build -w @uzenofuzet/core && npm test -w @uzenofuzet/core && npm test -w uzenofuzet-server && npm test -w @uzenofuzet/desktop
scripts.pack:desktop: npm run build -w @uzenofuzet/core && npm run pack -w @uzenofuzet/desktop
